description.en: Generic static mudpot teaching prop,5x4m nominal footprint and roughly0.7m low relief, not exact Yellowstone feature replica. NPS photographs support low muddy basin, thick clay, domes and collapsed bubble morphology. No live eruption/chemical assay/temperature/mineral composition/named feature claim. Colors and bubble placement artistic; gas motion not simulated.
